notes: Used the West Australian news-sitemap index by week (https://thewest.com.au/sitemap/2026/<week>/0/sitemap.xml) to collect URLs with <lastmod> dates. Gathered all weeks 1‑52, filtered to 2026-09-25..2026-10-25, deduped. Ensured >=15 URLs per day; missing days (none) would be supplemented via Wayback CDX fallback. Script writes TSV to data/urls_custom/thewest-com-au.tsv and prints per‑day counts. Verified sample articles have >1500 words and dates match within range.
